title: Biological conversion of CO2 for bioproduction: beyond natural limitations
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS01228G, Tutorial Review
Chunlei Zhao, Pan Zhu, Tiantian Chai, Jian Zhang, Xiulai Chen
This review summarizes advances in constructing synthetic CO2 bioconversion systems to facilitate the conversion of CO2 into value-added products by coupling CO2 fixation modules with energy supply modules.
